parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of steel, forming the main structural component that holds the internal mechanism and connects the lid and base.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the spring and staple track, ensuring proper alignment and pressure during stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It moves pivotally with the lid to press staples through paper when force is applied.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is made of durable plastic and covers the top portion of the stapler.
parts.Functional_description: It is the part most frequently pressed by the user to drive staples through paper and also provides access to the staple compartment when lifted.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge joint relative to the body, allowing it to open for staple loading and close for stapling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel and forms the bottom support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for the stapler, holds the anvil plate that bends the staple legs, and ensures proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing resistance against the downward force applied by the lid.
